verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review tool. It finds bugs in PRs and local changes, and codebase scans find bugs across a repository. Chat can take selected code with the diff and codebase as context, which gives some help narrowing root causes. Fixes can be generated with one click, and threads can close automatically when an issue is fixed, which is a light form of fix verification. Missing for 10: any capability to reproduce issues (running code, tests or failing scenarios), dedicated root-cause debugging workflows, verification of fixes by execution rather than re-review, and independent hands-on corroboration.
